patient.headline: 94歲男性，長期追蹤慢性腎臟病、青光眼、攝護腺肥大與甲狀腺機能低下，跨示範長青醫院及嘉恩醫院等多家院所就醫。

medicationEducation.name: Forxiga Film-coated Tablets 10mg
medicationEducation.benefit: 協助血糖管理，並經實證有助於心臟與腎臟功能的長期保護。
medicationEducation.attention: 請依指示規律服用，平時維持適度水分補充，若有尿路不適可於回診時向醫師反應。

medicationEducation.name: Eltroxin Tablets 100mcg 〝Germany〞
medicationEducation.benefit: 補充體內甲狀腺素不足，協助維持身體正常代謝活力與生理機能運作。
medicationEducation.attention: 建議每日固定時間服用，並配合醫師定期抽血追蹤甲狀腺功能數值。

medicationEducation.name: Feuri F.C. Tablets 80mg
medicationEducation.benefit: 減少體內尿酸生成，協助穩定血中尿酸濃度以預防痛風發作。
medicationEducation.attention: 請遵照醫囑劑量服用，日常注意補充足夠水分，不宜自行增減藥量。

medicationEducation.name: BRIMONIN OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION 0.15% / XALATAN 50?g/ml (0.005%) / COSOPT OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION
medicationEducation.benefit: 經由不同機轉調節眼內房水生成與排出，協助降低眼壓以保護視神經。
medicationEducation.attention: 點用多種眼藥水時，建議兩瓶之間間隔至少5分鐘，以利藥物充分吸收。

patient.headline: A 94-year-old man with chronic kidney disease, type 2 diabetes, hypothyroidism, and glaucoma, managed across multiple clinics and hospitals.

medicationEducation.name: Forxiga Film-coated Tablets 10mg
medicationEducation.benefit: Helps control blood sugar levels and supports kidney function.
medicationEducation.attention: Drink plenty of water unless your doctor has advised fluid restrictions, and report any signs of urinary discomfort.

medicationEducation.name: Eltroxin Tablets 100mcg
medicationEducation.benefit: Provides thyroid hormone to keep metabolism and energy levels balanced.
medicationEducation.attention: Best taken on an empty stomach in the morning with a full glass of water, about 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.

medicationEducation.name: Feburic 80 mg Film Coated Tablets / Feuri F.C. Tablets 80mg
medicationEducation.benefit: Lowers uric acid levels in the blood to help prevent painful gout flares.
medicationEducation.attention: Take consistently as directed, and stay well hydrated throughout the day.

medicationEducation.name: ARICEPT F.C. TABLETS 5MG
medicationEducation.benefit: Supports thinking, memory, and cognitive stability.
medicationEducation.attention: Take around bedtime as directed; let your clinician know if you feel persistent nausea or dizziness.

medicationEducation.name: XALATAN 50?g/ml (0.005%) / COSOPT OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION / BRIMONIN OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION 0.15%
medicationEducation.benefit: Lowers fluid pressure inside the eyes to help protect your vision from glaucoma.
medicationEducation.attention: When using multiple eye drops, wait at least 5 minutes between each different bottle to let each drop absorb properly.

changes.prompt: 比較病人最近的臨床資料與先前資訊，列出狀態、治療或結果中最重要的變化。強調需要注意的差異。
changes.text:
* 8/25 門診申報慢性腎臟病第 3b 期、高血壓性腎病、痛風及第二型糖尿病；8/27 紀錄眼科用藥與 Aricept，實際用藥請依藥袋為準。
* 腎功能於 5/25 至 6/02 間微幅波動（Cr 1.88 升至 1.93，eGFR 33 降至 32）；貧血指標 Hb 雖由 11.2 升至 12.1，但仍低於正常值。
* 8/17 因口腔撕裂傷接受抗生素、止痛藥及破傷風類毒素等短期治療，此非長期處方藥物。
* 診斷碼（含肺炎、貧血及未確認之申報碼）僅為申報資訊，並非正式診斷；任何用藥調整務必先與醫療團隊討論。

health-overview.prompt: 請用我匯入的個人健康資料，幫我整理一份白話版的健康總覽：目前的慢性病、正在使用的藥物，以及近期較需要關注的檢驗結果。專有名詞請在括號中簡單說明。最後提醒我若有疑慮應與醫師討論。
health-overview.text:
* 截至 8 月 27 日，藥物清單包含青光眼、Aricept、腎臟、血糖、甲狀腺、尿酸、葉酸及排便相關用藥，請務必與醫療團隊討論任何用藥異動。
* 8 月 25 日門診申報包含慢性腎臟病第 3b 期、高血壓性腎病、痛風及糖尿病；腎功能（eGFR）近期自 33 變動至 32，血色素由 11.2 升至 12.1 g/dL 但仍低於參考值，請持續追蹤。
* 8 月 17 日曾因口腔撕裂傷接受短期抗生素、止痛藥及破傷風類毒素治療，該處方不代表長期用藥。
* 門診申報碼（如肺炎、貧血或未確認代碼）並非最終確診報告，不應視為已確診疾病，請向原看診醫師確認確立之診斷。

changes.prompt: Compare the patient's recent clinical data to prior information and list the most important changes in status, therapy, or results. Emphasize deltas that require attention.
changes.text:
- August 25 claims list stage 3b chronic kidney disease and diabetes; note that insurance claims are not confirmed medical diagnoses.
- Renal indices declined between May and June 2026, while hemoglobin levels improved but remain below the reference interval.
- August 27 records show Aricept and ophthalmic preparations were dispensed; reconcile actual usage and discuss medication changes with your care team.
- An August 17 oral laceration involved a short-course treatment of antibiotics, analgesics, topicals, and tetanus toxoid.

Define medical terms briefly when needed. End with a reminder that I should discuss specifics with my doctor.
health-overview.text:
- August 27 updates include medications for glaucoma, Aricept, and treatments for kidney, glucose, thyroid, uric acid, folate, and bowel conditions.
- Claims from August 12 and 25 include codes for CKD, diabetes, gout, pneumonia, and anemia; insurance claim codes are not confirmed diagnoses.
- Between May 25 and June 2, eGFR decreased (33 to 32) and hemoglobin improved (11.2 to 12.1 g/dL), remaining below reference range.
- An August 17 visit involved a short-course treatment for an oral laceration. Discuss all health conditions and medication changes with your care team.

alerts.title: Anticholinergic and pro-cholinergic co-prescribing with retention risk
alerts.detail: Oxybutynin 5mg ER and Imipramine 25mg BID antagonize Donepezil 5mg while markedly worsening urinary retention and delirium risks in this 94-year-old male with BPH and delirium history.
evidence: History of BPH and delirium F05
alerts.recommendation: Review indications for oxybutynin and imipramine; consider deprescribing strong anticholinergics to protect cognitive function and reduce urinary retention risk.

alerts.title: Suboptimally controlled hypothyroidism on levothyroxine
alerts.detail: TSH was elevated at 14.7 uIU/mL (2026-01-14) despite Eltroxin 100mcg daily.
alerts.recommendation: Recheck thyroid function panel (TSH, Free T4) and assess medication adherence.

alerts.title: Dapagliflozin use with declining renal function
alerts.detail: Forxiga 10mg daily continued with eGFR declining to 32 mL/min/1.73m2 (creatinine 1.93 mg/dL on 2026-06-02).
evidence: eGFR 32 mL/min/1.73m2 and Creatinine 1.93 mg/dL on 2026-06-02
alerts.recommendation: Monitor renal function and volume status; glycemic efficacy of SGLT2 inhibitors declines below eGFR 30 mL/min/1.73m2 although renal/cardiovascular benefit may persist.

alerts.title: 抗膽鹼藥物與膀胱鬆弛劑合併使用提醒
alerts.detail: 病患目前處方包含 Oxybutynin 5mg、Mirabegron 50mg、Tamsulosin 0.4mg 及三環抗憂鬱劑 Imipramine 25mg，需注意排尿順暢度。
evidence: 2026-08-04 開立 Oxbu Extended-release 5mg 與 Betmiga 50mg
alerts.recommendation: 建議於泌尿科或家醫科門診追蹤時，主動告知醫師是否有解尿困難或尿流變慢等情形。

alerts.title: 腎功能指標追蹤注意
alerts.detail: 最近一次腎絲球過濾率為 32 mL/min/1.73m2，數值呈現漸進追蹤趨勢。
alerts.recommendation: 請遵醫囑定期返診追蹤腎功能與血液生化指數，並維持穩定用藥與水分攝取。

alerts.title: 便秘藥物重疊開立注意
alerts.detail: 示範長青醫院與示範嘉恩醫院於 2026 年 6 至 8 月間皆有開立番瀉葉（Sennosides）排便用藥。
evidence: 長青醫院 2026-08-25 開立 THROUGH 28 天份
嘉恩醫院 2026-07-20 開立 THROUGH 28 天份
alerts.recommendation: 軟便劑請依當前排便狀況與醫師指示調整服用，避免兩家院所之同類藥品同時重複服用。

alerts.title: High TSH indicating suboptimal thyroid hormone replacement
alerts.detail: TSH was elevated at 14.7 uIU/mL on 2026-01-14 despite ongoing Eltroxin Tablets 100mcg 〝Germany〞 therapy.
alerts.recommendation: Check follow-up thyroid function panel and adjust levothyroxine dosage if indicated.

alerts.title: Dual antimuscarinic/anticholinergic therapy in elderly male with BPH
alerts.detail: Patient was co-prescribed IMIMINE S.C. TABLETS 25MG and Oxbu Extended-release Tablets 5mg, which increases risk of urinary retention and worsening delirium.
alerts.recommendation: Review indications for imipramine and oxybutynin; monitor post-void residual urine volume and cognitive status.

alerts.title: SGLT2i use with reduced renal function
alerts.detail: Forxiga Film-coated Tablets 10mg is prescribed with eGFR 32 mL/min/1.73m2; glucose-lowering efficacy is reduced.
alerts.recommendation: Monitor eGFR and renal function periodically; ensure adequate hydration.

alerts.title: Combined anticholinergic and urinary medications
alerts.detail: Concomitant use of oxybutynin, imipramine, and mirabegron with tamsulosin was prescribed on 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-05, which may increase the chance of urinary retention or dry mouth in older adults.
alerts.recommendation: Review urinary symptom response and monitor for voiding difficulties or pronounced dry mouth with your prescribing physician.

alerts.title: Elevated TSH under levothyroxine therapy
alerts.detail: TSH was measured at 14.7 uIU/mL on 2026-01-14 while taking levothyroxine 100 mcg daily.
alerts.recommendation: Discuss a routine follow-up thyroid blood test with your physician to ensure optimal dosage.

alerts.title: Renal function monitoring with SGLT2 inhibitor
alerts.detail: Forxiga (dapagliflozin) is being continued with recent eGFR readings around 32 to 35 mL/min/1.73m² (most recently 32 mL/min/1.73m² on 2026-06-02).
alerts.recommendation: Continue scheduled renal panel checks as planned by your kidney care clinic.
